facts.value: Earn an online Master of Arts in criminal justice from Arizona State University to elevate your career in justice leadership. This program offers a deep understanding of the causes and impacts of crime and how the legal system is structured to respond. You’ll examine challenges in the justice system and gain the skills to drive positive change through policy and program reform.
